name: @seanhogg/bfi-node
description: VENDORED build of bfi-node (builderforce-inference crates/bfi-node, napi-rs over bfi-engine): Synapse's 1-bit Bonsai (GGUF Q1_0) engine as a native Node addon — native wgpu (Vulkan / Metal / DX12) or every CPU core — exposed as the BfiEngine JS class of PRD 34 §3.1. One prebuilt bfi_node.<platform>-<arch>.node per platform. Not published — hosts consume it by `link:`. Rebuild with `node scripts/vendor-bfi-node.mjs`; SOURCE.json records the commit and file hashes this copy came from.
